# v1.1.0-dev.107: Minimize, maximize, and clicks that land

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.106`.

## Minimize and maximize on the title bar

A virtual window's title bar now has its own minimize and maximize buttons.
Minimizing takes its docked windows with it. While it's maximized, the maximize
button turns into restore.

## Maximized without clipping

A maximized virtual window used to push the edges of its docked windows off the
screen, by as much as 29 pixels. Windows maximizes a window with its resize
border hanging past the screen edge, and the panes were laid out on that larger
area. They now stay inside what you can see, and so does the virtual window's own
title bar.

## Clicking a virtual window while WLM is in front

With WLM's main window selected, a click on a virtual window could go nowhere:
its buttons didn't respond, and dragging it could stick. Pressing a virtual
window hands focus to the window docked in it, and doing that in the middle of
the click took the mouse away from the virtual window. When WLM is the active
app, the handoff now waits until you let go.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
